description: This file defines the class 'S3EncryptionMultipartUploaderV2', which extends the 'MultipartUploader' class to handle encrypted multipart uploads to Amazon S3. It encapsulates functionality for encrypting data, managing upload states, and integrating with AWS SDK for PHP to perform multipart uploads of encrypted objects to S3 with support for custom metadata strategies and encryption parameters.

classes.name: S3EncryptionMultipartUploaderV2
classes.description: A specialized multipart uploader for encrypting and uploading objects to S3, supporting encryption parameters, various strategies, and custom callbacks for upload process customization.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported by the SDK for encryption.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the multipart uploader with encryption settings, AWS client, source data, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Provides the default metadata strategy for storing encryption envelope information.

methods.name: getEncryptingDataPreparer
methods.description: Returns a closure that defers the encryption of data until the promise is executed, managing the encryption envelope and parameters.
